about: Photoshop brush oracle (probes/brush-strokes.jsx): every recorded case, classified, with our measured distance. Coverage is 0..1; px are image pixels. Regenerate with PAGED_PHOTOSHOP_LEDGER=write (image-js tests/it/brush_photoshop.rs).

round-d40-h0-single.note: Photoshop's soft falloff is a Gaussian-like bell that reaches PAST the nominal radius (hardness 0: half coverage at ~0.55 R, 9 % at R, ~2 % at 1.25 R); the engine's tip is a hardness plateau plus a smoothstep that ends exactly AT R. Same centre, same size class, a different curve: recorded, not copied.

round-d40-h50-single.note: Photoshop's soft falloff is a Gaussian-like bell that reaches PAST the nominal radius (hardness 0: half coverage at ~0.55 R, 9 % at R, ~2 % at 1.25 R); the engine's tip is a hardness plateau plus a smoothstep that ends exactly AT R. Same centre, same size class, a different curve: recorded, not copied.

round-d40-h100-single.note: At hardness 100 both are a disc of radius R with an antialiased rim; Photoshop's rim is ~2 px wide and centred a little inside R (0.68 at R-0.5, 0.19 at R+0.5), the engine's is the 1 px AA band ending at R (0.5 at R-0.5).

round-d10-h100-sp100.note: Overlapping dabs: the stroke's extent and coverage are compared; the residual is the rim difference of the round tip (see the single-dab rows), accumulated along the stroke.

round-d40-h100-a30-r40.note: Angle positive = counter-clockwise on screen; roundness squashes the minor axis. The rim residual is the round tip's (see the single-dab rows).

sampled-a0.note: Orientation, mirror and the flip-then-rotate order agree with Photoshop (axis within 0.5 deg). Photoshop's sampled stamp sits ~0.45 px toward the tip's top-left corner IN TIP SPACE (the offset flips and rotates with the tip, so it is a half-texel centring of the bitmap, not a placement error); the engine centres the bitmap on the dab exactly.
